name: How do I decide whether to keep my existing kitchen layout or reconfigure it?

mainEntity.name: How do I decide whether to keep my existing kitchen layout or reconfigure it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to keep or change your layout depends on how well your current space functions and how much budget you allocate to mechanical changes. If your kitchen feels cramped, lacks prep space, or isolates you from adjoining living areas, reconfiguring the layout or removing an interior wall delivers better daily utility. However, moving sinks, dishwashers, and ranges requires relocating rough plumbing, venting, and electrical lines, which increases labor costs. If your existing work triangle operates smoothly, keeping the layout lets you invest more of your budget into premium finishes, cabinets, and appliances.
acceptedAnswer.description: Keep the layout if workflow functions well to save on plumbing and electrical labor; reconfigure it if you need better storage, traffic flow, or an open-concept connection.
